run_monolingual_wordsim_evaluation: run the evaluate.py script to perform monolingual word similarity evaluation on source embeddings
run_crosslingual_wordsim_evaluation: run the evaluate.py script with --tgt_lang to perform crosslingual word similarity evaluation
run_word_translation_evaluation: run the evaluate.py script with source and target embeddings to evaluate word translation quality
run_sent_translation_evaluation: run the evaluate.py script with crosslingual args to evaluate sentence translation quality
build_model_with_embeddings: build a model using build_model with source and target embeddings via evaluate.py CLI
